name: The Haughty Troupe
caption: A tag team of two veteran wrestlers past their prime, defeated by the House of Hill on RLW's own debut broadcast.

tenures.source: The Slamtrack 1 broadcast (22 August 2014), served under this wing.

name: The House of Hill
caption: A stable of three wrestling brothers from St. Paul, Minnesota, who defeated the Haughty Troupe on RLW's own debut broadcast.

tenures.source: The Slamtrack 1 broadcast (22 August 2014) and Slamtrack 4's own Red Crown Tournament quarterfinal (29 October 2014), both served under this wing.

name: The Marsupials of Mayhem
caption: An Australian-themed heel stable led by Kid Koala, whose own announced roster names a fourth member, Possum, who never appears individually in the record.

tenures.source: The Slamtrack 2 broadcast (11 September 2014) through the Slamtrack 8 broadcast (3 April 2015), both served under this wing.
Signed in on 16 July 2009 and billed against Las Tres Estrellas de Galáctico on the FMLL II card.

name: J-MAX
caption: A precision tag-team stable formed in Japan under manager Lisa Loeh; the fed's own broadcast names a third member, Paco Losantio, who never wrestles individually in the record.

tenures.source: The Slamtrack 5 broadcast (7 December 2014) and the Rush Hour broadcast (11 January 2015), both served under this wing.

name: The Hashtag Bros
caption: A tag team of Johnny Dorn and BookFace, defeated by the Marsupials of Mayhem on RLW's own seventh broadcast.

tenures.source: The Rush Hour broadcast (11 January 2015) and the Slamtrack 7 broadcast (1 March 2015), both served under this wing.

name: Winners & Losers
caption: A cousin tag team billed as the Prince of Pinfall and the Bjelkez Butcher, attacked by the Marsupials of Mayhem on RLW's own second broadcast.

tenures.source: The Slamtrack 2 broadcast (11 September 2014), served under this wing.
